title: Fuel Economy Feedback
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly praise the G60's fuel economy, while a few criticize higher-than-expected consumption or, in one EV example, difficult long-distance charging and several others mention fuel economy without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews specifically describe the G60's fuel economy or fuel consumption as very good, excellent, or satisfying.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention lower-than-expected real-world fuel economy and one example about difficult long-distance charging that is grouped under this topic.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention fuel economy alongside other attributes or intended benefits without stating whether the experience was good or bad.

limitations: Only a subset of topic fragments is provided as examples, so some sentiment details are not directly observable here.
One negative example concerns long-distance charging rather than fuel consumption, so the topic cluster may include related but not identical efficiency subjects.
Undetermined examples are brief and do not provide enough context to infer a clear evaluation.
